text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a lunch break one day, the central courtyard was lively.
At the center of the students holding up their smartphones stood――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well then, how does something like this sound?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: For you... I present this super cute Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Cute Curren Chan...
Cute Curren Chan...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Um...! May I post this to UmaStagram
with the hashtag #CuteCurrenChan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thank you♪ Fill your Umastagram
with tons of Curren, okay?☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The photo session seems to be an absolute sensation.
The heat radiating from the crowd is so intense the air looks warped...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, lunch break is almost over!
Time sure flies when you're hanging out with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~?! But I still want to take lots more two-shots with Curren Chan~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Right? Curren wants to do that too, but...
choice_data_list: Line up so we can take photos efficiently!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay~, what a great idea☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We'll save taking a picture of just the two of us for next time♪ Let's all gather together for an aerial shot! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I have a drone borrowed from the Chairwomanâª Here, come join me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Here we go, everyone~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turns out she had an incredible network of connections.
Everyone was thrilled, and the photoshoot was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, maybe I'll ask you
to take charge and round everyone up~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everyone~! Line up in front of Curren, okay?☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're the last one♪ Thanks a bunch☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay~, amazing, amazing! I was able to deliver cuteness to everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're so reliable☆
Ehehe, you really saved me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We managed to wrap up the photoshoot within the lunch break.
She looks more than satisfied!
